instruction: cachetools.TLRUCache.expire(time=None) removes the expired items but returns nothing. Make it return an iterable of the (key, value) pairs it removed, as TTLCache.expire already does: an empty iterable when nothing has expired at that time, otherwise each removed item once with the value it held. Items deleted or replaced earlier aren't reported again, and the cache's contents after expire() stay as before.
